knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Most records are generally kept 5 years, longer where a review period runs beyond that.
Matching job record, invoice and payment shows income, deposits and payments line up.
A deposit recorded as income before the job is done is corrected to a liability and the change noted.

practicalCriteria: Learner builds a job record linking quote, condition record, invoice and payment, and reconciles a supplied month of bank lines with at least three planted mismatches resolved.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed artefact saved with date and version
Assessor record of knowledge check result
stopWorkCriteria: Learner treats a tax, licence or environmental point as settled without checking it
